response.text: Payment journals agree with APPAYM for every payment. Now I'll confirm the invoice-to-journal mismatches (671 and 802) with a clean evidence query, and check the duplicate pair's journal posting.

arguments.sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", j."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS ap_credit, SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr FROM public."APINVH" i JOIN public."GLJRNH" j ON j."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" JOIN public."GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=j."JRNL_NO" AND TRIM(l."ACCT_CD")='2000' GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", j."JRNL_NO" HAVING ROUND(SUM(l."CR_AMT")::numeric,2)<>ROUND(i."INV_AMT"::numeric,2)
